description: Recording HTTP proxy between the emulators and your server (no app or server change): action start points every device's system proxy at it (10.0.2.2:<port+k>), stop clears it, log returns the request log. Judge the log with the judge tool's `log` input (dupSuccess / lostUpdate / lostWrite / idle).

loseAcks.description: fault injection: share of writes whose answer is dropped after the server committed them

target.description: start: server base URL as seen from the host, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5599

name: proxy
